back: i before e, except after c, when the sound is ee: believe, field; receive, ceiling.
notes: Exceptions: seize, weird, protein, either, neither.

back: Before a vowel suffix, double if the word ends vowel + consonant and the stress is on the last (or only) syllable: run → running, begin → beginning.
notes: No doubling: visit → visited, offer → offered.

back: A final l after one vowel doubles before a vowel suffix: travelled, cancelled, labelled.
Drop it before a vowel suffix (hoping, usable); keep it before a consonant suffix (hopeful, movement).
notes: Exceptions: argument, truly, ninth; noticeable and courageous keep e.

back: Consonant + y → i before suffixes (happily, carried), but keep y before -ing (carrying).
notes: Vowel + y keeps y: played, enjoyment.

back: The suffix -ful has one l (careful); with -ly it becomes -fully (carefully).
